Simply great. I think that the easiest way to describe this app is “simple”.
Succinct, easy to set up, and a broad range of rain sounds, all for free. If you like to imagine yourself in some remote locale gently drifting off to sleep, here is your portal. Or if you just wish some rain with your slumber, than this is simple enough. I’ve enjoyed some other apps with differing “white noises” akin to bonfires, shorelines, and more, which were all good in their own way, but this app offers the broadest range of rainfall I’ve ever encountered, from gentle showers to thundering storms, from all over the globe.
While you could spend more upon a similar app, I doubt you would find any that are better than this one. If you like this sort of thing, then it is most definitely recommended.
